comment: The prompt template for a regional set's cover (#114), kept apart from prompts.json so that a change here never repaints the pack art (each pack's art lock records prompts.json's version). FLUX.3 Image Klein reads a caption of the finished picture, so the template describes the result: a wide watercolour landscape of the set's edition theme ({edition_theme}, set.json's `edition.theme`, e.g. 'citrus groves, chaparral hills and warm golden valley light'), with a pale open sky across the upper third for the Listen tab's title and an empty land: no bird in focus, no animal or person, no building, road or sign, no lettering, no map and no border (design guide page 14: covers are illustrative, never a map or evidence of a sighting's place). The distilled model runs without guidance, so there is no negative prompt; the trial paints of 2026-11-02 kept every one of the exclusions. Bump the version when the template changes: every set's cover lock records it, and its cover is painted again for review.
template: A wide hand-painted landscape in transparent watercolour with touches of gouache on warm cold-press paper, filling the picture edge to edge: {edition_theme}. An open, quiet view with lush detailed plants in the foreground, a soft middle distance and far hills under a wide, pale sky across the upper third, painted in layered washes with fine, confident brushwork, natural colours and gentle atmospheric depth, like the cover of a regional field guide. The land is empty and still: no birds, no animals, no people, no buildings, no roads, no signs, no lettering, no map and no border.
